validation_usage: The 499-example labeled SHROOM validation set was repeatedly used for evaluation and experiment decisions. Treat it as development data, not a fresh independent test set.

overlap_audit.interpretation: Exact normalized overlap checks only. The model-agnostic track has 19 exact hypothesis matches; the model-aware track has none. The model-agnostic sensitivity analysis shows little metric change after excluding the 19 matches. Semantic overlap is not tested.

limitation: Official SHROOM test evaluation is available for the saved baseline. These results do not establish that confidence-aware variants generalize better. Exact-string checks cannot prove full independence, and validation was reused during development.
